verdict.rationale: Workers docs directly state that developers can write Workers in non-JavaScript languages, naming Python and Rust explicitly. Containers additionally allow code in any language to run as part of Workers apps. A 2024 community comment citing a lack of Python support is dated user sentiment rather than a concrete failure of the current documented capability. Missing for 10: explicit Go support evidence, in-depth language-specific docs (runtime limits, tooling), independent hands-on corroboration of Python/Rust Workers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write edge functions in languages other than JavaScript such as Python, Go, or Rust

citations.quote: Use your preferred language, including JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Rust, and more
Run code written in any programming language, built for any runtime, as part of apps built on Workers.
